rules.label: 01 Account parent changes
rules.description: Blocks Parent Account changes on SYN-MM-/SYN-RULE- Accounts when enabled.

rules.label: 02 Contact account changes
rules.description: Blocks Account changes on SYN-MM-/SYN-RULE- Contacts when enabled.

rules.label: 03 Lead qualification
rules.description: Requires previously saved Lead Status to equal Required Value before native conversion.

rules.label: 04 Won deal minimum
rules.description: Requires Amount greater than or equal to Numeric Value in USD when saving Stage Closed Won.

rules.label: 05 Won deal primary contact
rules.description: Requires an existing primary Contact Role when saving Stage Closed Won. Insert as open first.

rules.label: 06 Case resolution
rules.description: Requires nonblank Demo Resolution when saving Status Closed. No emails or SLA automation.

rules.label: 07 Task due date
rules.description: Requires Due Date when saving Status Completed; does not close the related Case.

rules.label: 08 Active campaign responses
rules.description: Blocks member Status changes for inactive SYN-MM-/SYN-RULE- Campaigns. No email is sent.
